thread:
maria: Heads-up — we've got a carve-out request from legal to fully stop routing to v1 for a subset of tenants by end of next month. Need a safe rollback + telemetry plan.
jonathan: Ok — are we talking hard cut (return 410) or transparent fallback to v2?
kevin: Legal wants guaranteed no execution on v1. So requests must not hit v1 runtime. We can return a 410 + `X-Compat-Advice` header pointing to migration docs.
sara: If we return 410 for some tokens, we need console UX to surface which tenants will be affected and why. Also quota behavior if clients retry aggressively.
jonathan: Agreed. Proposal: 1) Router will short-circuit matching tokens to a new route `v1-erased` that returns 410 + JSON body. 2) Console shows a banner + per-tenant list. 3) Telemetry: emit `v1.erasure.attempt` with sample rate 100% for first week, then 5%.
kevin: For safety we should enable a `safe_mode` flag at tenant-level so SRE can opt a tenant into a grace proxy that maps to v2-compatible shim for a limited window. But legal said no execution on v1, mapping to v2 is ok for some tenants if data residency rules allow.
maria: Can we avoid accidental token affinity? We have sticky routing keys in the edge cache. Need plan to evict sticky state before enforcement window.
jonathan: Router change will accept `X-Force-Version` header override for internal ops during rollout. We'll add a migration purge job that calls `POST /internal/evict-sticky` for token prefixes. Schedule: rolling evict over 24h before enforcement.
sara: Dashboards — add a new chart: `v1.erasure.attempts` by tenant, and `v1.erasure.rate` (percent of v1 calls that hit erasure). Also alert if any tenant > 1% of requests still hitting legacy route after enforcement.
infra-bot: deploy queued: routing-change-v1-erasure (canary -> 3 clusters). Tests: unit + integration + evict-job dryrun.
kevin: Quotas: If clients hit 410 and retry, they'll consume no tokens on v1 but could air traffic to v2. Need to ensure quota deduction happens only on the execution route. Add server-side idempotency hints for common SDKs to reduce retry storms.
maria: UX todo for Console: per-tenant migration checklist, opt-in `safe_mode` toggle for platform ops, and ability to download list CSV of affected token hashes. Also add copyable `X-Compat-Advice` snippet.
jonathan: Telemetry detail: emit `v1.erasure.reason` tag (legal|security|billing), `evict_job.progress` metric with counts, and log a structured event for each eviction: `{token_prefix, tenant, timestamp, evict_result}`. Sampling 100% for errors only.
sara: I'll draft dashboard tiles and an alert runbook. Will also add a small migration guide in Console docs.
kevin: We need a rollback: keep `v1` runtime available for 7 days pinned to maintenance mode to allow forensic replay if legal asks. But router will ignore normal traffic. Only ops with `X-Force-Version` can execute.
maria: Sounds good. Action items: jonathan implement router short-circuit + header override (ETA 3 days), kevin implement evict job + idempotency hints (ETA 5 days), sara dashboard + console copy (ETA 4 days). I'll coordinate legal comms and tenant notifications.
jonathan: I'll open the PR and add unit tests for header precedence and sticky eviction API.
sara: tagging infra-bot for canary when PRs are ready.
infra-bot: canary promoted to staging cluster at 6801234590.
maria: Thanks — let's sync tomorrow 10am to confirm canary metrics before scheduling purge.
